tasks.name: 新向量维护
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ═══ 向量漂移定点修复：检测 → 清洗 → 修复（L0 + L1） ═══
(async () => {
  // ====== 配置 ======
  const DETECT_ONLY = 0;         // true = 只跑阶段一并输出计划，不做任何修改
  const CLEAN_L0 = true;             // 是否清洗漂移楼的 L0 数据（锚点+l0Index+其state向量）
                                     //   false = 漂移楼只清 L1；锚点保留（语义可能基于旧文本，会过期）
  const DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST = true;// 缺 digest 的存量 L0 向量：true=删除（锚点保留，自动重嵌，绝对正确）
                                     //                          false=只补写当前 digest（零成本，赌没改过）
  const REEXTRACT_L0 = true;         // 清洗后是否调 LLM 重新提取缺失锚点（false = 留待手动增量提取）
  const MAX_L0_REEXTRACT = Infinity; // 单次重提取楼层上限（控制 LLM 花费）
  const EMBED_BATCH = 10;
  const EMBED_MAX_RETRY = 2;
  const RETRY_WAIT_S = 30;

  const toast = (m, t = 'info') => { console.log('[漂移修复]', m); window.toastr?.[t]?.(m, '向量漂移修复', { timeOut: 6000 }); };
  const delay = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

  try {
    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const ctx = getContext();
    const chatId = ctx?.chatId;
    const chat = ctx?.chat || [];
    if (!chatId || !chat.length) return toast('❌ 未打开聊天', 'error');

    const BASE = '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary';
    const [reconcile, cs, ss, dg, svi, crp, si, cfg, emb, mem, db, lex] = await Promise.all([
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/text-hash-reconcile.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/chunk-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/state-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/vector-input-digest.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-repair.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-integration.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/config.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/embedder.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/memory-commit.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/db.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/retrieval/lexical-index.js`),
    ]);

    // ── 守卫 ──
    const vectorCfg = cfg.getVectorConfig();
    if (!vectorCfg?.enabled || !vectorCfg.embeddingApi?.key) return toast('❌ 向量检索未启用或未配置 API Key', 'error');
    const meta0 = await cs.getMeta(chatId);
    const fingerprint = emb.getEngineFingerprint(vectorCfg);
    if (meta0?.fingerprint && meta0.fingerprint !== fingerprint) {
      return toast('❌ 引擎指纹不匹配（换过 embedding 模型），请先「完整重建」，定点修复无意义', 'error');
    }
    const embedWithRetry = async texts => {
      for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
        try { return await emb.embed(texts, vectorCfg); }
        catch (e) {
          if (attempt >= EMBED_MAX_RETRY) throw e;
          toast(`⚠️ embed 失败，${RETRY_WAIT_S}s 后重试（${attempt + 1}/${EMBED_MAX_RETRY}）`, 'warning');
          for (let s = RETRY_WAIT_S; s > 0; s--) await delay(1000);
        }
      }
    };

    // ═══ 阶段一：检测 ═══
    toast('🔍 阶段一：检测漂移...', 'info');
    const lastChunkFloor = meta0?.lastChunkFloor ?? -1;
    const driftFloors = await reconcile.findStaleTextHashFloors(chatId, chat, lastChunkFloor);

    const atoms = ss.getStateAtoms();
    const stateVecs = await ss.getAllStateVectors(chatId);
    const events = ctx.chatMetadata?.extensions?.LittleWhiteBox?.storySummary?.json?.events || [];
    const evVecs = await cs.getAllEventVectors(chatId);
    const chunkRows = await cs.getAllChunks(chatId);
    const chunkVecRows = await cs.getAllChunkVectors(chatId);
    const chunkRowIds = new Set(chunkRows.map(c => c.chunkId));
    const chunkVecIds = new Set(chunkVecRows.map(v => v.chunkId));
    const chunksNoVec = chunkRows.filter(c => !chunkVecIds.has(c.chunkId));
    const orphanChunkVecs = chunkVecRows.filter(v => !chunkRowIds.has(v.chunkId));

    const atomById = new Map(atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId).map(a => [String(a.atomId), a]));
    const vecByAtom = new Map(stateVecs.map(v => [String(v.atomId), v]));
    const evById = new Map(events.filter(e => e?.id).map(e => [e.id, e]));

    const stateDangling = stateVecs.filter(v => !atomById.has(String(v.atomId)));
    const stateStale = stateVecs.filter(v => {
      const a = atomById.get(String(v.atomId));
      return a && v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('state', a.semantic);
    });
    const stateNoHash = stateVecs.filter(v => {
      const a = atomById.get(String(v.atomId));
      return a && !v.sourceHash;
    });
    const atomsNoVec = atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId && a.semantic && !vecByAtom.has(String(a.atomId)));
    const evDangling = evVecs.filter(v => !evById.has(v.eventId));

    console.table({
      'L1漂移楼': driftFloors.length,
      'L1缺向量块(→补齐缺漏自动修)': chunksNoVec.length,
      'L1孤儿向量(本脚本不处理)': orphanChunkVecs.length,
      'L0过期向量(digest不等→重嵌)': stateStale.length,
      'L0缺向量(→重嵌)': atomsNoVec.length,
      'L0缺digest(按DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST处理)': stateNoHash.length,
      'L0 dangling(无主向量→删)': stateDangling.length,
      'L2 dangling(已删事件→删)': evDangling.length,
    });
    if (driftFloors.length) console.log('漂移楼层(0-based):', driftFloors.join(', '));

    // ═══ 仅检测模式：输出执行计划后停止，不做任何修改 ═══
    if (DETECT_ONLY) {
      let l0MissingFloors = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < chat.length; i++) {
        if (!chat[i] || chat[i].is_user) continue;
        const st = ss.getL0FloorStatus(i);
        if (st?.status !== 'ok' && st?.status !== 'empty') l0MissingFloors++;
      }
      const driftAiFloors = driftFloors.filter(f => chat[f] && !chat[f].is_user).length;
      const keyL0Clean = `将删L0锚点楼(CLEAN_L0=${CLEAN_L0})`;
      const keyDigest = `缺digest向量(${DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST ? '将删+重嵌' : '将补digest'})`;
      const keyReextract = `L0待提取楼(若REEXTRACT_L0=${REEXTRACT_L0})`;
      console.table({
        '将删 L1 漂移楼': driftFloors.length,
        [keyL0Clean]: CLEAN_L0 ? driftAiFloors : 0,
        '将删 dangling(state/event)': `${stateDangling.length}/${evDangling.length}`,
        [keyDigest]: stateNoHash.length,
        '将重嵌 L0 锚点(含以上删除产生的)': atomsNoVec.length + stateStale.length + (DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST ? stateNoHash.length : 0),
        'L1 将补嵌块数': chunksNoVec.length,
        [keyReextract]: l0MissingFloors + (CLEAN_L0 ? driftAiFloors : 0),
      });
      toast('🔍 仅检测完成：未做任何修改，执行计划见 console.table', 'info');
      return;
    }

    // ═══ 阶段二：清洗 ═══
    const driftSet = new Set(driftFloors);
    if (driftFloors.length || stateDangling.length || evDangling.length
      || (DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST && stateNoHash.length)) {
      toast(`🧹 阶段二：清洗（漂移楼 ${driftFloors.length}）...`, 'info');

      // 2a L1：漂移楼连块带向量删
      for (const f of driftFloors) await cs.deleteChunksAtFloor(chatId, f);

      // 2b L0：漂移楼锚点删除（CLEAN_L0 开关）draft + commitSummaryMemory 原子提交，retire 维护回执
      if (driftFloors.length && CLEAN_L0) {
        try {
          const previous = mem.readSummaryMemory();
          const next = structuredClone(previous);
          const removedAtomIds = [];
          next.stateAtoms = (next.stateAtoms || []).filter(a => {
            if (a && driftSet.has(a.floor)) { removedAtomIds.push(a.atomId); return false; }
            return true;
          });
          let idxRemoved = 0;
          next.l0Index ||= { version: 1, byFloor: {} };
          for (const f of driftFloors) {
            if (next.l0Index.byFloor[String(f)] !== undefined) { delete next.l0Index.byFloor[String(f)]; idxRemoved++; }
          }
          // retire 回执中涉及这些楼锚点的变更（照抄 anchor-invalidation.js 的卫生逻辑，改成按楼层集合）
          let retired = 0;
          for (const batch of next.storySummary?.summaryHistory || []) {
            for (const receipt of batch.maintenance || []) {
              for (const operation of receipt.operations || []) {
                for (const change of operation.changes || []) {
                  if (change.collection !== 'anchors' || change.retired) continue;
                  const hit = (change.before && driftSet.has(change.before.floor))
                    || (change.after && driftSet.has(change.after.floor));
                  if (!hit) continue;
                  change.retired = { reason: 'drift_repair', at: Date.now() };
                  retired++;
                }
              }
            }
          }
          if (removedAtomIds.length || idxRemoved) {
            await mem.commitSummaryMemory(chatId, next, { previous, invalidate: async () => {
              if (removedAtomIds.length) await ss.deleteStateVectorsByIds(chatId, removedAtomIds);
            } });
            console.log(`[漂移修复] L0 清洗：锚点 ${removedAtomIds.length}，索引 ${idxRemoved}，retire 回执变更 ${retired}`);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          toast(`⚠️ L0 锚点清洗失败（${e?.message || e}），继续修 L1`, 'warning');
        }
      } else if (driftFloors.length && !CLEAN_L0) {
        console.log('[漂移修复] CLEAN_L0=false：漂移楼 L0 锚点保留（语义可能基于旧文本）');
      }

      // 2c dangling 向量（纯垃圾残留，不受开关控制）
      if (stateDangling.length) await ss.deleteStateVectorsByIds(chatId, stateDangling.map(v => v.atomId));
      if (evDangling.length) await cs.deleteEventVectorsByIds(chatId, evDangling.map(v => v.eventId));

      // 2d 缺 digest 向量（DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST 开关）：删除 → 锚点保留，落进阶段三重嵌队列
      if (DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST && stateNoHash.length) {
        await ss.deleteStateVectorsByIds(chatId, stateNoHash.map(v => v.atomId));
        console.log(`[漂移修复] 已删缺 digest 向量 ${stateNoHash.length} 条（锚点保留，将重嵌）`);
      }

      // 正文变了 → 词法索引对漂移楼已过期，作废重建
      if (driftFloors.length) await lex.invalidateLexicalIndex();
      toast(`🗑️ 清洗完成：L1 楼 ${driftFloors.length}、L0 dangling ${stateDangling.length}、L2 dangling ${evDangling.length}${DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST ? `、缺digest向量 ${stateNoHash.length}` : ''}`, 'success');
    } else {
      toast('ℹ️ 无需清洗', 'info');
    }

    // ═══ 阶段三：修复 ═══
    toast('🛠️ 阶段三：修复...', 'info');

    // 3a L1：官方全量对账补齐（缺块/缺向量/刚删的漂移楼全部重切重嵌，带 sourceHash）
    let l1Repaired = 0, l1Failed = null;
    try {
      const l1 = await crp.repairMissingChunks({
        chatId, chat, vectorConfig: vectorCfg,
        onProgress: (cur, total) => { if (total && cur % 100 === 0) console.log(`[漂移修复] L1 补嵌 ${cur}/${total}`); },
      });
      if (!l1.success) { l1Failed = l1.code || 'unknown'; toast(`⚠️ L1 补齐未完成（${l1Failed}），已修 ${l1.repaired ?? 0} 块`, 'warning'); }
      else l1Repaired = l1.repaired ?? 0;
    } catch (e) {
      l1Failed = e?.message || String(e);
      toast(`⚠️ L1 补齐异常：${l1Failed}`, 'warning');
    }

    // 3b L0：重嵌（缺向量 + digest 过期 + 刚被 2d 删掉的）+（DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST=false 时）补写缺失 digest
    const stateVecs2 = await ss.getAllStateVectors(chatId);
    const vecByAtom2 = new Map(stateVecs2.map(v => [String(v.atomId), v]));
    const reembed = [], digestMap = new Map();
    for (const a of atoms) {
      if (!a?.atomId || !a.semantic) continue;
      const v = vecByAtom2.get(String(a.atomId));
      const wantSrc = dg.inputDigest('state', a.semantic);
      const wantRel = dg.inputDigest('relation', svi.buildRAggregateText(a));
      if (!v) reembed.push(a);
      else if (v.sourceHash && (v.sourceHash !== wantSrc || (v.rVector && v.relationHash !== wantRel))) reembed.push(a);
      else if (!DELETE_MISSING_DIGEST && (!v.sourceHash || (v.rVector && !v.relationHash))) {
        digestMap.set(String(a.atomId), { wantSrc, wantRel });
      }
    }
    let reembedded = 0, embedError = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < reembed.length; i += EMBED_BATCH) {
      const batch = reembed.slice(i, i + EMBED_BATCH);
      try {
        const texts = [];
        for (const a of batch) texts.push(String(a.semantic), svi.buildRAggregateText(a));
        const vecs = await embedWithRetry(texts);
        await ss.saveStateVectors(chatId, batch.map((a, j) => ({
          atomId: a.atomId, floor: a.floor,
          vector: vecs[j * 2], rVector: vecs[j * 2 + 1],
          sourceHash: dg.inputDigest('state', a.semantic),
          relationHash: dg.inputDigest('relation', svi.buildRAggregateText(a)),
        })), fingerprint);
        reembedded += batch.length;
        console.log(`[漂移修复] L0 重嵌 ${reembedded}/${reembed.length}`);
      } catch (e) {
        embedError = e?.message || String(e);
        toast(`⚠️ L0 重嵌在第 ${i} 条处失败：${embedError}，跳过剩余（重跑本任务可续）`, 'warning');
        break;
      }
    }
    if (digestMap.size) {
      const raw = await db.stateVectorsTable.where('chatId').equals(chatId).toArray();
      const patch = [];
      for (const r of raw) {
        const w = digestMap.get(String(r.atomId));
        if (!w) continue;
        r.sourceHash = w.wantSrc;
        if (r.rVector) r.relationHash = w.wantRel;
        patch.push(r);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < patch.length; i += 500) await db.stateVectorsTable.bulkPut(patch.slice(i, i + 500));
      console.log(`[漂移修复] 补写 digest ${patch.length} 条`);
    }

    // 3c L0 锚点重提取（LLM）：漂移楼锚点已删 → 状态变 missing，全量扫描自动排队重提取+向量化
    let l0Built = 0, l0FailedFloors = 0;
    if (REEXTRACT_L0) {
      try {
        toast('🧠 L0 锚点重提取中（LLM，数量见检测表 missing 楼数）...', 'info');
        const r = await si.incrementalExtractAtoms(chatId, chat,
          msg => console.log('[漂移修复] L0:', msg),
          { maxFloors: MAX_L0_REEXTRACT, retryFailedFloors: true });
        l0Built = r?.built ?? 0;
        l0FailedFloors = r?.failed ?? 0;
        toast(`✅ L0 重提取完成：${l0Built} 楼新锚点，失败 ${l0FailedFloors} 楼`, l0FailedFloors ? 'warning' : 'success');
      } catch (e) {
        toast(`⚠️ L0 重提取异常（${e?.message || e}），可稍后手动跑增量提取补`, 'warning');
      }
    }

    // ── 终检 ──
    const meta2 = await cs.getMeta(chatId);
    const driftAfter = await reconcile.findStaleTextHashFloors(chatId, chat, meta2?.lastChunkFloor ?? -1);
    console.table({
      'L1修复块数': l1Repaired, 'L0重嵌': reembedded, '补digest': digestMap.size,
      'L0重提取楼': l0Built, 'L0重提取失败楼': l0FailedFloors,
      '剩余漂移楼': driftAfter.length, 'L1失败码': l1Failed ?? '-', 'L0重嵌失败': embedError ?? '-',
    });
    driftAfter.length === 0 && !l1Failed && !embedError
      ? toast(`🎉 修复完成：L1 ${l1Repaired} 块，L0 重嵌 ${reembedded}/重提取 ${l0Built} 楼，漂移清零`, 'success')
      : toast(`⚠️ 修复完成但有残留项，见 console.table`, 'warning');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[漂移修复] 脚本异常（报 xxx is not a function = 模块缓存旧版，先 Ctrl+F5）:', e);
    window.toastr?.error(`脚本异常: ${e?.message || e}`, '向量漂移修复', { timeOut: 8000 });
  }
})();
<</taskjs>>
